REFIT_HYPOTHESES_NO_CMB_RESULT_V2_SUPERSEDED.json (PV predict lacked mu_model(z): CF4 'dmzp' is a distance modulus, slope ~5.2 per dex in z; PV chi2 13745 was this bug, NOT missing peculiar-velocity scatter as suggested earlier)
authorisation: User decisions 2026-11-12: NPIPE/PR4 excluded; re-fit approved on remaining channels; then 'record input hashes' and 'add nuisance + free psi' approved. Unblinded run on those channels; NOT the CORE-07 production inference.

operator.optimizer: L-BFGS-B, 3 starts per hypothesis; success=True for all

inputs.excluded: CMB (Planck PR4 carrier and MC100 covariance) never loaded
inputs.provenance_note: Quasars, Radio and Gaia inputs are earlier DERIVED result files (measured count dipoles with covariance; Gaia VSH coefficients), not raw catalogues; Quasars and Radio share one JSON (same hash). SNe is the 490-object Pantheon+ residual cache; PV is the CF4 operator file (1000 of 35970 groups subsampled by stride); DESI is the DR2 BAO mean/cov text.

modes.fixed_psi: psi at fiducial (H0 67.4, Om 0.315, r_d 147.09, DeltaOmega_k 0)
modes.free_psi: H_0 in [50,90], Omega_m in [0.05,0.60], DeltaOmega_k in [-0.30,0.30] free (declared bounds); r_d fixed (BAO degenerate with H_0); SNe/PV absolute offsets analytically marginalised

results.note: default file is alpha 0.75; alpha 0.5 and 1.0 in *_ALPHA0.5/1.0.json; see BOOST_TENSION_RECEIPT.json for beta estimates and the tension analysis

caveats: SNe (433/490) and PV (903/1000) are now adequate; DESI 29/13 at fiducial psi, 10/13 with free psi.

H_mix Gaia block 58.6 -> 0.4 with 5 shear parameters: the Gaia input is an 11-coefficient vector with 6 nuisance modes marginalised, so ~5 effective data are fitted by 5 shear parameters (exactly identified): chi2 ~ 0 is saturation, not evidence for shear. The fitted shear (|sigma5| ~ 1e-2) is not a measurement. Delta_BIC(H_mix)=+2.1 but Delta_AIC(H_mix)=0.0 (H_loc +40.6): ranking depends on the penalty, and is not evidence.
H_tilt chi2 equals the null exactly: beta_RM does not enter any enabled channel (structural non-identification).
Free psi: Omega_m 0.293, H_0 68.8, DeltaOmega_k +0.021; only the DESI block improves (29 -> 10); r_d fixed, parameters bounded, not cosmological estimates.
Quasars/Radio/Gaia inputs are earlier DERIVED result files; point estimates only; no uncertainties, no posterior sampling, no matched-null calibration; not the CORE-07 production inference.
Count responses now derived (see BOOST_TENSION_RECEIPT.json); the 'tension with SN/PV' statement of v3 is WITHDRAWN (SN/PV uninformative, dchi2 ~4-6.5/3 dof).
Two of four count blocks are hard-coded literals without a source file (provenance defect).
